instruction: Design a system that combines the two given modules: a barrel shifter and a 4-to-1 multiplexer. The barrel shifter should have three inputs (CLK, SHIFT, and DATA) and one output (SHIFTED_DATA). The 4-to-1 multiplexer should have four input signals and one output signal. The select signal should be a 2-bit signal that selects which input signal is routed to the output. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in both the SHIFTED_DATA and the output of the 4-to-1 multiplexer to get a final output. The functional module should perform a bitwise OR operation on the two inputs to produce the final output.
